main.description: The account asking: by the session cookie the pages' login sets, or a service token. Nothing, for no one.

accounts.description: The other accounts this browser is logged in to, which it can switch to without logging in again; absent when none.

actor.description: The account asking; absent when no one is.

admin.description: Whether the account asking is one of this appview's operators, who moderate it and see how it is used; absent when not.

delegated.description: Whether this appview's gateway writes for the account asking, which delegated writes to it: collaborators push to its repositories through it, and runners land their merge queues. Absent when not.

login.description: Whether this appview's pages can log people in: it is an OAuth client, with a public URL.

organization.description: Whether the account asking is an organization: it keeps a public dev.knotless.org record. Absent when not.

reauth.description: Whether the account asking logged in to these pages asking for less than they ask for now, as before they came to do more: logging in again grants the rest. Absent when not.

redelegate.description: Whether this appview's gateway writes for the account asking under a grant asking for less than it asks for now: delegating writes to it again grants the rest. Absent when not.

spaces.description: Whether the account asking has a PDS with spaces, which private repositories live in; absent when no one asks, or this appview does not know yet.

description: Who is asking this appview, as its pages show it.
